scope: All runtime-exported Exception-derived types and every NAM-declared public instance diagnostic property including inherited NAM fields; exact compiled metadata set equality without suffix filtering.
unreviewedScope: CLR-inherited Exception diagnostics, other API/lifecycle/private/demo roles, required complete useful-work performance corrections and final native/shipping/Review gates remain explicit distinct work. This registry is not the complete release inventory.

fields.definition: Owner or handle type description, not a stable owner identifier or address.

fields.resetPolicy: Captured exception lifetime; property observation never resets, acquires authority, changes owner state or frees storage.
fields.overflow: Existing checked/saturating producer rules apply before the decision; property reads perform no arithmetic or wrapping. Valid zero identity/state values remain model-specific.
